caption: The arrows trace the certificate 1,2,3,4,5 on the worked example's graph, so the verifier's five edge lookups are 12, 23, 34, 45 and the closing edge 51 — all present. Ten pairwise comparisons confirm the five vertices are distinct, so the check costs O(n²) time, which is what puts HAMILTONIAN CYCLE in NP.

spec.aria: A graph on vertices 1 to 5 with the certificate cycle drawn as arrows 1 to 2 to 3 to 4 to 5 back to 1, plus two dashed extra edges 13 and 24.
